{{Quote|Who is this agent?"<br />"Her codename is Skimmer. Her whereabouts are unknown. She joined the rebellion after both her father and brother were killed during earlier campaigns waged against the Empire.|A Rebel operative and a Rebel Coordinator|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Lyda Skims''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]], code named '''Skimmer'''. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], she was responsible for stealing information on a secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] project called [[Project Dead Eye]]. While evading capture, Lyda transmitted information on the [[Dead Eye Prototype]] to the Alliance, and was eventually rescued by an operative sent to rescue her.

==Biography==
===Early life===
====Life on Corellia====
Around [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]],<ref name="Birthdate" /> a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] by the name of Lyda Skims was [[Birthday/Legends|born]] to [[Lynn Skims|Lynn]] and [[Doyle Skims]]. She also had brother by the name of [[Athon Skims|Athon]]. She spent her early life on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]],<ref name="Dossier" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> where she worked at her mother's textile facility. Her work there gave Lyda a broad knowledge of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] design as well as [[Engineer/Legends|engineering]] and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] repair. Lyda cultivated other interests during this [[Time/Legends|time]], including arts and modern dance.<ref name="Dossier" />

====Tradition of service====
Both Lyda's father and brother served on the side of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the course of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Athon, who worked as a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]], was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during a delivery to Alliance contacts on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] at the time of its [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] by the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Lyda's father suffered a similar fate in the subsequent [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], where he was killed while [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]] during the assault on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. After the devastating losses of both her brother and her father, and the selling off of her mother's business, Lyda made the decision to join the Alliance in order to continue her family's tradition of service. Though she lacked significant combat skills, she served as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]], code named "Skimmer," on undercover missions for the Alliance<ref name="Dossier" /> in about [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref>

===Project Dead Eye===
====Undercover at an Imperial signals facility====
{{Quote|What happened on your mission?"<br />"I'd been assigned some safe, boring undercover work. Just watch and report on troop movements at an Imperial signals facility. One night this file got routed to my station. It looked important, so I stole Wes's&hellip;uh&hellip;my supervisor's security cylinder to decode it and make a copy. It was a little outside my mission profile, but it seemed important.|A Rebel operative and Lyda Skims|<ref name="AED" />}}
Lyda's assignment initially comprised of relatively safe, boring undercover work, where she watched and reported on [[Troop/Legends|troop]] movements at an [[Imperial signals facility]]. During her time there, she became close friends with one of the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]], a supervisor of hers by the name of [[Wes (Imperial officer)|Wes]]. One night, a file got routed to her station. Believing it to be important, she stole Wes' [[Code cylinder/Legends|security cylinder]] to decode it and make a copy. Upon doing so, she realized the report concerned details on [[Project Dead Eye]],<ref name="LydaConversation">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Conversation with "Lyda Skims"}}</ref> an experimental [[Spice/Legends|drug]] concocted by Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Vacca]] to enhance the efficacy of frontline [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].<ref name="RebelTransmission">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Encoded Rebel Transmission}}</ref> There was not enough information in the report to duplicate the process of creating the formula. However, it did reveal that the drug required the use of [[Alderaanian Flora]], a rare [[Plant/Legends|plant]] which used to grow on Alderaan. When the Empire discovered that Wes' security cylinders were used to access the [[Dead Eye Prototype|Dead Eye]] plans, he realized that Lyda was the only one who could have stolen them.<ref name="LydaConversation" />

====Cover blown====
{{Quote|You all know it'll break Lyda's mom's heart if we can't get her home safe. She's lost enough in the last few years, and now her daughter's off risking her neck. Lyda's spunk may have taken her a bit too far this time. Let's be careful out there.|Bren Derlin in a decoded Rebel transmission|<ref name="AED" />}}
[[File:CoAAct2Panel4.png|250px|thumb|Lyda Skims captured by Imperial forces after attempting to surveil their operations.]]
Lyda believed Wes to be a good man who did not harbor much love for the Empire. In fact, she believed he would be willing to help the Rebellion once his tour was up. Nevertheless, Lyda understood that Wes would have no other choice but to turn her in. Otherwise, he himself would be accused of being a spy. With her cover blown,<ref name="LydaConversation" /> Lyda promptly went into hiding for a period of several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]].<ref name="Act2">{{SonyCite|url=story_arc.jsp?id=58778&page=Story%20Arc|text=The Cries of Alderaan Act 2: Loyalties}}</ref> [[Datacard/Legends|Datadiscs]] outlining the initial report of her findings were intercepted by the Alliance, but were misappropriated by several underworld organizations, including the [[Meatlumps]] and various [[Swooper/Legends|swoopers]]. [[Agent/Legends|Agents]] in the field had some luck recovering the disks, but many remained missing.<ref name="Dossier" />

In an encrypted Rebel transmission, Rebel Alliance [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]], who was well acquainted with Lyda and her family, expressed a desire to return her to safety.<ref name="RebelTransmission" /> The Rebel leader [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], eager for more information on the project, also took a personal interest in finding Lyda before the Empire did.<ref name="Act2" /> In fact, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tiaan Jerjerrod/Legends|Tiaan Jerjerrod]] of the Galactic Empire sent an emergency alert to all [[Officer/Legends|officers]] concerning Lyda. In this transmission, Moff Jerjerrod urged that any Rebels associated with the delivery of documents related to the secret research project be [[Death/Legends|terminated]] with extreme prejudice.<ref name="ImperialTransmission" /> Still in hiding, though committed to her mission, Lyda attempted delivery of a datadisc at a designated drop zone. She was hampered, however, by a previously unknown Imperial patrol in the drop area. Rather than abort the mission, she attempted surveillance, but she was caught and charged with trespassing.<ref name="Dossier" />

====Capture and escape====
{{Quote|I'm sorry your Highness, Lyda's been in hiding for weeks now."<br />"Lyda? We have to find her before the Empire does. We need that information. I hope she's alright&hellip;|A [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="Act2" />}}
An Imperial [[Transport/Legends|transport]] was dispatched to deliver her for processing. However, when the transport experienced a mechanical failure, she used that opportunity to make her escape into the wilderness. Undeterred by these events, Lyda soon resumed surveillance of the Imperial signals facility. In an effort to get better footage of their operations, she climbed a fence and was detected. However, she this time managed to evade capture by fleeing back into the wilderness.<ref name="Dossier" /> By this point, the Empire turned to the public for assistance in capturing Lyda. The [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] released a public news alert on the [[Imperial HoloVision]], urging citizens to be on the lookout for the Rebel operative. The report admitted that she was responsible for stealing documents related to the Dead Eye project.<ref name="Email">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|E-mail: "Imperial HoloVision News Alert"}}</ref> Although her reconnaissance efforts were cut short, data acquired from the surveillance operation proved to be of the highest quality.<ref name="Dossier" /> One encoded datadisc fell into the possession of a Rebel sympathizer, who happened to be Lyda's friend.<ref name="SWGAct2">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Rebel Quest: "Cries of Alderaan Act 2: Loyalties"}}</ref>
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}

====On the run====
{{Quote|I don't think I can avoid capture. It's only a matter of time before I'm spotted. I've never seen so many stormtroopers! In fact, I'm a little bit flattered that I've caused this much commotion.|Lyda Skims in an encoded datadisc message|<ref name="AED" />}}
Rebel Coordinators tasked with the responsibility of overseeing Lyda's progress instructed another operative of theirs to rendezvous with her friend and retrieve the disk.<ref name="SWGAct2" /> Lyda used an obscure encryption scheme for the disk, as it was the only crypto she had available, and she did not want to risk interception of the message. Upon being decoded by the Rebellion, the datadisc revealed Lyda's concerns. She did not think she could avoid capture for much longer, and believed it would only be a matter of time before she was spotted again. In the report, Lyda mentioned seeing many [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. The report also contained more information on the specifics of Project Dead Eye. Namely, that the powerful drug was being developed by the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] Dr. Vacca, and that by improving [[Eye/Legends|eyesight]], the Dead Eye formula increased hand-eye coordination and reduced [[Scope/Legends|scope]] drift. As a result, the drug had the potential to turn the Empire's lowliest grunt into a super soldier. Lyda's report mentioned that given the destruction of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] by the Empire, Vacca's loyalties could be turned in favor of the Rebellion. In the conclusion of her report, Lyda asked the Rebellion to send her love to her mother.<ref name="DecodedDisk">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Dead Eye Disk [decoded]}}</ref>

====Rescue and extraction====
{{Quote|Lyda's alive? Thank the stars. We'll send out a team to get her right away. You do good work. If you're up for it we need someone to deliver this disk and report to one of our Rebel Commanders about Lyda and project Dead Eye.|A Rebel Coordinator, to a Rebel operative|<ref name="AED" />}}
After decoding the report, a Rebel Coordinator dispatched their operative to find Lyda and see if she was still alive. In the meantime, Lyda managed to remain in hiding until the operative tracked her down. Upon being located, Lyda was ambushed by a group of five thugs, however they were fended off by her fellow comrade.<ref name="SWGAct2" /> Lyda thanked her rescuer, and divulged additional details about her mission. Lyda, ready to conclude her assignment, instructed the operative to return to the Rebel Coordinator and send for a larger extraction team to return her to safety.<ref name="LydaConversation" /> The perilous mission evidently did not phase Lyda very much. Shortly after her rescue, Lyda already began requesting more assignments, much to the chagrin of the Rebel Coordinator tasked with rescuing her, who bemoaned her headstrong and risk-averse demeanor.<ref name="SWGAct2" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|How is Lyda doing?"<br />"Fine, but headstrong as ever. She is already requesting more assignments. She should be careful what she wishes for. This isn't her first time jumping to light speed without checking her charts.|A Rebel operative and a Rebel Coordinator|<ref name="AED" />}}
Lyda lacked any significant proficiency in combat. However, her technical skills, tenacious nature and fearlessness led her to be an exceptional choice for undercover missions. Though she possessed a great many qualities such as courage, resourcefulness and intelligence, her youthful exuberance often led her to go beyond the scope of her missions.<ref name="Dossier" /> Bren Derlin worried that her spunk had the risk of taking her too far.<ref name="RebelTransmission" /> A Rebel Coordinator likewise criticized her for being headstrong, as well as impulsive in the face of danger.<ref name="SWGAct2" /> When Lyda found herself stranded in the wilderness, she worried that her luck had finally run out, and that her capture was inevitable. However, she maintained an upbeat demeanor throughout the ordeal, and had even felt a bit flattered at the measure of attention she had attracted from the Empire.<ref name="DecodedDisk" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Thanks for the assist. I thought I was bantha fodder for sure that time.|Lyda Skims, to a Rebel operative|<ref name="AED" />}}
During the time of her investigations into Project Dead Eye, Lyda Skims wore a beige and [[Color/Legends|brown-colored]] cold weather [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]] overtop a tan-colored dress blouse [[shirt]]. This simple [[Clothing/Legends|outfit]] was complemented by a pair of beige dress slacks and similarly colored hide boots.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lyda Skims was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> She was featured as part of "[[W:c:swg:Cries of Alderaan|The Cries of Alderaan]]" [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] line,<ref name="SWGAct2" /> an episodic story arc broken into three acts.<ref name="CoAFAQ">{{SonyCite|url=story_arc.jsp?id=57554&page=Story%20Arc|text=Story Arc FAQ}}</ref> Following the debut of ''[[The Cries of Alderaan Act 1: Codes]]'' on [[August 12]], 2003,<ref name="Act1">{{SonyCite|url=story_arc.jsp?id=57987&page=Story%20Arc|text=The Cries of Alderaan Act 1: Codes}}</ref> Lyda was mentioned in the game, albeit rather indirectly in the form of a series of encoded transmission fragments. These transmissions, when decoded, revealed the first name of "Lyda," and the codename "Skimmer."<ref name="RebelTransmission" /> However, the transmissions were presented to the player as an unintelligible cryptogram puzzle designed by Chief Creative Officer, [[Raph Koster]], who revealed that it would require the collaboration of players outside the game to solve.<ref name="DecodeForum">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Development&message.id=323382|text=Monthly Story, How to decode the message.}}</ref> Players worked together for several days to decrypt the encoded text.<ref name="Newsletter">{{SonyCite|url=old_newsletters/newsletter_0903.html|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies Newsletter #2 &ndash; Sep, 2003}}</ref> As part of [[W:c:swg:Publish 3 Notes: 8 October 03|Publish 3 The Warren]] on [[October 8]], 2003,<ref name="Publish3">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60890|text=Publish 3: The Warren}}</ref> Lyda Skims appeared for a limited time as an actual NPC for the Rebel version of the continued quest line. As part of this quest, Rebel players were tasked by Rebel Coordinators to meet with a friend of Lyda to retrieve an encoded datadisc. Players were then tasked to locate Lyda herself, fight off five thugs, and converse with her.<ref name="SWGAct2" /> Lyda also appeared in "Alliance Operative Field Dossier - Skimmer", a ''Star Wars Galaxies'' website article written from an [[in-universe]] perspective,<ref name="Dossier" /> as well as ''[[The Cries of Alderaan Act 2: Loyalties]]'' webcomic, published along with the launch of Act 2.<ref name="Act2" /> Due to its nature as a limited-time event, Lyda Skims could no longer be encountered following the conclusion of the story's second act.<ref name="SWGAct2" /> Conflicting sources pose a discrepancy regarding Lyda's eye color. "Alliance Operative Field Dossier – Skimmer" listed Lyda's eye color as blue,<ref name="Dossier" /> whereas the actual character model used for Lyda Skims depicted her with brown eyes.<ref name="AED" />
